sources.transform: Use the source material reference for a small authored Tarmin wall-sconce silhouette, quantized into the Project Tarmin stone palette. The raw pack remains staging-only.
Select four source frames, key the black background transparent, remap fire colors to ember/gold tokens, and downsample nearest-neighbor to a 128x48 four-frame sheet.

runtimePolicy: Only transformed derivatives are loaded by Phaser. Sconces and flame frames are presentation-only; they do not create visibility, lighting, or simulation state.
